claim_ceiling.statement: The exact curve differential representation for Cecotti B.7/B.8 is projectively equivalent to the retained plus-r ordered pair (S,T^-1), but the source package does not source-bind the period/homology normalization selecting one target-inner conjugate. Composing the literal intertwiner with the 48 retained principal-polarized CM automorphisms leaves 48 integral markings (24 projective conjugator classes modulo +/-I), whose action on the candidate fixed W-line is L1/L2/L3 = 16/16/16. Therefore the lifted differential/period constraints currently source-bound do not select an absolute retained W-line.

raw_basis_is_not_direct_Qr_lattice_basis.claim: No nonzero scalar lambda in Q(r) makes lambda*Q0 a matrix over Q(r).
raw_basis_is_not_direct_Qr_lattice_basis.proof: Because Q0_22=1, lambda*Q0 over Q(r) forces lambda in Q(r); then lambda*(1-sqrt2) in Q(r) with lambda nonzero would force sqrt2 in Q(r), contradiction.
raw_basis_is_not_direct_Qr_lattice_basis.interpretation: A period/homology normalization between the raw curve differential basis and the retained torus/lattice basis is genuinely required; this is not an impossibility result.

lifted_target_inner_ambiguity.family_of_exact_intertwiners: Q_h = Q0 * h^-1 for h in <S,T>; Q_h intertwines the fixed source pair with (h S h^-1, h T^-1 h^-1).
lifted_target_inner_ambiguity.candidate_fixed_line_seed: L2, the unique fixed W-line of literal S*T^-1
lifted_target_inner_ambiguity.consequence: The exact differential representation and the unmarked ppav/CM structure retain the full three-line ambiguity.

period_homology_gap.missing: A source-bound normalization tying the branch-labelled raw differential basis to one symplectic homology basis / A-period matrix underlying the retained period coordinates.
period_homology_gap.why_period_matrix_alone_does_not_select: The displayed period matrix describes the ppav only after a symplectic marking. Composing that marking with any retained ppav automorphism preserves the unmarked ppav while moving the three nonzero W-lines transitively.
